name: carbamide peroxide
uses: Uses For occasional use as an aid to soften, loosen and remove excessive ear wax
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use ▪ if you have ear drainage or discharge ▪ ear pain ▪ irritation or rash in the ear ▪ dizziness ▪ an injury or perforation (hole) of the eardrum ▪ recently had ear surgery Stop use and ask a doctor if ▪ you need to use for more than four days ▪ excessive ear wax remains after use this product
